source: Agent kit scan grounded in the current catalog ability text (data/catalog/heroes.json, pred.gg); first pass 2026-06-18 from hero-abilities.json.
note: THEORY: qualitative kit reads for coaching — archetype, core combo, win condition, power spike, passive's in-fight effect, who to play WITH, and how to play AGAINST. Not sim output; a structured read of the kit text. powerSpike/scaling in {early,mid,late}; waveClear/dive in {low,med,high}.

adele.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
adele.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
adele.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
adele.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
adele.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

akeron.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
akeron.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
akeron.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
akeron.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
akeron.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

argus.combo: Ether Crystal pushes then implodes to pull enemies together, Dread Nova stuns the group, Particle Shredder homes in, then Synaptic Obliterator beams finish low targets
argus.winCondition: poke from long range, zone with Ether Crystal and land Dread Nova stuns into Obliterator beams
argus.passive: abilities apply Disintegration stacks that make further ability hits deal more damage
argus.playWith: a frontline to protect him while he channels Synaptic Obliterator
argus.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova, his only stun; dive him during the Synaptic Obliterator channel when he is immobile, and keep health high since beams hit harder on missing health; magic armor blunts his damage

aurora.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
aurora.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
aurora.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
aurora.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
aurora.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

bayle.combo: Skull Crusher leaps in to shred armor and speed him toward the target, Cursed Edge's third slash knocks up and stuns, Dire Howl slows and buffs him, then Kingslayer uppercuts and pummels a hero
bayle.winCondition: engage, sustain through Dire Howl omnivamp, and out-brawl with Berserk when low
bayle.passive: below 35% Max Health he goes Berserk with attack speed, movement speed and tenacity, once every 20s
bayle.playWith: follow-up damage while he commits the dive
bayle.playAgainst: dodge the horizontal third slash of Cursed Edge and sidestep the Kingslayer dash during its slowed charge-up; burst him through Berserk or disengage until it ends; anti-heal cuts Dire Howl healing and armor helps against his physical damage

boris.combo: Detection Protocol marks and tracks a hero, Chrono Swipe dashes in to consume the Mark for a slow and a Canister, Primeval Roar gives damage reduction then fears, and Ursine Burst grabs and slams the target
boris.winCondition: track a target out of position, then grab and slam them for the kill
boris.passive: every second basic attack grants Canisters for attack speed and on-hit healing; at max Canisters his Tesseract Core zaps and heals
boris.playWith: a team that collapses on the hero he grabs
boris.playAgainst: Ursine Burst hovers briefly before the dash, so sidestep it or stay behind your frontline; back off from Primeval Roar until it explodes to avoid the fear; fight after Detection Protocol is spent; anti-heal trims his Canister healing

countess.combo: Shadow Slip dashes in, Eventide and Blade Siphon hit to apply Haemorrhage, then Feast suppresses the Haemorrhaged target for bonus damage and full healing, with Shadow Slip recast to swap back out
countess.winCondition: Feast a Haemorrhaged squishy for bonus damage, heal it back, and escape through the Shadow swap
countess.passive: hitting a hero with two abilities within a short window applies Haemorrhage, a max-health true-damage bleed
countess.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
countess.playAgainst: Feast is her engage, so peel or punish after it is spent; note where her Shadow was left, since she can swap back to it; magic armor and anti-heal blunt her Blade Siphon and Feast healing

crunch.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
crunch.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
crunch.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
crunch.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
crunch.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

dekker.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
dekker.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
dekker.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
dekker.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
dekker.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

drongo.combo: Old Rusty slows on the way out and back, Gag Grenade silences, Rad Rounds stacks Irradiate on basics, then Shrapnel Cannon shreds armor and erupts Irradiate
drongo.winCondition: kite from range, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, and use Shrapnel Cannon to shred or escape
drongo.passive: critical strikes and ability hits apply a max-health bleed
drongo.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
drongo.playAgainst: dodge Gag Grenade's silence; Shrapnel Cannon cast in the air launches him away and is briefly unstoppable, so engage after it is used; armor blunts his physical damage

eden.combo: poke with Sidewind's Railshot and Tachyon Lance at range, swap with Zero Shift, dash in with Talon Drive and Axiom Strike, then Limit Break once Overheated
eden.winCondition: build Heat by damaging heroes and unload Limit Break, flexing between range and melee
eden.passive: damaging heroes builds Heat; at max Heat she Overheats and unlocks Limit Break, and Heat decays if she stops hitting heroes
eden.playWith: peel that lets her keep damaging heroes to build Heat safely
eden.playAgainst: disengage to let her Heat decay before she Overheats; punish melee stance after Talon Drive is spent, and buy anti-heal against her melee stance healing; armor blunts her physical damage

feng-mao.combo: Reaping Dash in, Hamstring twice to slow, Safeguard to block the key ability, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on a kill
feng-mao.winCondition: trade with Safeguard up and chain Earth Shatter executes and Reaping Dash cooldown resets in fights
feng-mao.passive: unique hero takedowns permanently grant bonus physical penetration, and all his physical penetration is increased
feng-mao.playWith: setup that holds a target for the Earth Shatter execute
feng-mao.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's Spellshield before committing your key CC; back off when low, since Earth Shatter executes and recasts on a kill; armor counters his physical damage

gadget.combo: Security Gate roots, Sticky Mine is empowered by a basic attack, Seek and Destroy follows the target, then Tesla Dome traps the fight
gadget.winCondition: root with the gate and hold enemies inside the Tesla Dome while it shreds magical armor
gadget.passive: FDA stacks from kills, ability hits and takedowns permanently grant magical power
gadget.playWith: frontline that holds enemies inside the Dome
gadget.playAgainst: do not walk through Security Gate; leave Tesla Dome early since it grows larger; with no mobility in the kit, dive Gadget after the gate is used; magic armor helps

gideon.combo: Void Breach slows, the empowered basic attaches a Cosmic Tether that roots, Cosmic Rift lands on the rooted target, then Black Hole drags the group together
gideon.winCondition: land Black Hole and Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for area burst
gideon.passive: hitting a hero with an ability empowers his next basic attack to tether the target, dealing damage then rooting them
gideon.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
gideon.playAgainst: dodge Void Breach and Cosmic Rift; Torn Space is his only escape, so dive him after it is used; walk out of Black Hole early since it drags slowly; magic armor blunts his burst

greystone.combo: Assault The Gates leap in, Make Way to shred armor, Sacred Oath empowered cleave to slow, then Stone Forged Soul to heal in Stasis and crash down.
greystone.winCondition: Stay in the middle of fights and use Stone Forged Soul's missing-health heal to reset, while Make Way shreds armor for the team.
greystone.passive: Stoicism deflects the next basic attack on a cooldown and grants health regen and armor that grow as he loses health.
greystone.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow his leap and benefit from Make Way's armor shred.
greystone.playAgainst: Do not burst into Stone Forged Soul's Stasis; step away from the slow and the crash, then re-engage. Open with an ability since Stoicism deflects a basic, and buy anti-heal to cut the ult heal.

grim-exe.combo: Energy Shield to block an incoming ability, Assault Mode for long-range cleaving basics, Displacement Blast to push enemies away, GTFO to finish a fleeing target.
grim-exe.winCondition: Out-trade with Pulsefire true damage and long-range Assault Mode basics, then chase kills across the map with GTFO.
grim-exe.passive: Pulsefire makes his basics deal magical damage and his next basic or ability bursts a mark for true damage.
grim-exe.playWith: Frontliners who peel and keep divers off him while he shoots from range.
grim-exe.playAgainst: Bait Energy Shield with a cheap ability, then land your real CC. GTFO is blocked by enemy heroes, so a teammate can body-block it for a low target; dive him while he is slowed channeling it.

grux.combo: Stampede to drag a target, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power, then Double Pain to cleave and heal.
grux.winCondition: Chain pull and stuns onto one target while Bloodlust bleed stacks and Warlord's Challenge attack speed shred them.
grux.passive: Bloodlust makes basics stack a bleed for damage over time.
grux.playWith: Follow-up damage that can hit the target he drags and stuns.
grux.playAgainst: Stampede has a delay before the charge and Smash 'n Grab channels before the shockwave, so sidestep both. Fight after he spends them, and buy anti-heal against Double Pain's heal.

howitzer.combo: H11 Cluster Grenades and Land Mine to slow and stun, R2000 Missile charged for full damage, then Make It Rain on the held enemies.
howitzer.winCondition: Lock down space with grenades and mines and rain missiles on enemies stuck in them.
howitzer.passive: Armed Salvo empowers his next basic with area damage that restores mana, and each ability cast shortens its cooldown.
howitzer.playWith: CC and chokepoints that force enemies into his zones.
howitzer.playAgainst: Walk around grenades and get out of Land Mine's blast before it goes off. He can blast himself away with Land Mine, so engage after it is used; magical armor helps against his burst.

iggy-scorch.combo: Oil Spill to slow, Molotov to ignite the oil, Flame Turrets to keep shooting, then Inferno and its knockback belch.
iggy-scorch.winCondition: Layer oil, fire and turrets on a choke or objective and burn the team that has to stand in it.
iggy-scorch.passive: Badlands Critter basics stack Slick, a slow that lets his fire ignite the target.
iggy-scorch.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire and oil.
iggy-scorch.playAgainst: Do not fight in his oil and fire; flank around it. Melee basics break Flame Turrets quickly, and turrets go inactive when he moves away from them, so drag the fight off them; magical armor helps.

ikra.combo: Hydroclasm bubble to slow, Narcosis to suspend a hero, pop the amplified bubble with Brine for extra damage and penetration, then Genesis knockup.
ikra.winCondition: Poke with bubbles popped by Fathom and Brine, then catch a hero with Narcosis and burst them.
ikra.passive: Herald changes his kit based on the chosen Eternal category, from damage and cooldowns to healing or anti-heal.
ikra.playWith: Teammates with follow-up damage or CC that can hit a hero he suspends.
ikra.playAgainst: Narcosis stops on the first hero it hits, so a tanky teammate can block it for a carry. Leave a bubble's radius before it amplifies, and fight after Narcosis is down; magical armor helps.

kaelen.combo: Rimefang to stun, slow and lay Rimeglass, Winter's Pursuit onto the Frostbitten target to root them, Razorstorm on Rimeglass, then Frostfall to crash down and root the center.
kaelen.winCondition: Fight on his Rimeglass, where Razorstorm boosts his armor and Frostbite deals max health true damage and sets up Winter's Pursuit roots.
kaelen.passive: Heart of Ice makes his abilities leave Rimeglass that slows and burns enemies with Frostbite.
kaelen.playWith: Damage dealers who can follow up on his roots and Frostfall.
kaelen.playAgainst: Step off Rimeglass so Frostbite ends before Winter's Pursuit can root you. Frostfall channels before he leaps, so move out of the center of the landing and leave the Rimestorm; tenacity helps against the roots.

kallari.combo: Shadow Walk into Camouflage, Crippling Dagger to slow, Shadow Dance onto the Death Marked target for double damage, then Guillotine to execute.
kallari.winCondition: Catch an isolated low-health target from Camouflage and finish them with Guillotine's missing-health damage.
kallari.passive: Death Mark reveals targets she damages and detonates for missing-health true damage, and she can jump extra times in the air.
kallari.playWith: A team that follows up on her picks and fights around vision.
kallari.playAgainst: Ward and stay near teammates since nearby heroes and wards reveal Camouflage. Guillotine has a brief delay before the dash, so CC her during it or after Shadow Dance; stay healthy since her damage grows on low targets.

khaimera.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
khaimera.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
khaimera.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
khaimera.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

kira.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
kira.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
kira.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
kira.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
kira.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

kwang.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
kwang.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
kwang.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
kwang.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
kwang.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

legion.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
legion.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
legion.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
legion.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
legion.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

lt-belica.combo: Void Drone for vision and mana drain, Seismic Assault to knock up and stun, Void Bomb, then Neural Disruptor to silence and finish.
lt-belica.winCondition: Drain mana with Void Drone and land Seismic Assault, then burst with Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage.
lt-belica.passive: Innovation upgrades each ability at max rank and grants ability haste.
lt-belica.playWith: Follow-up damage during Seismic Assault's knockup and stun.
lt-belica.playAgainst: Seismic Assault erupts after a short delay, so sidestep the line. Avoid casting near Void Drone since it zaps and drains mana, and dive her after Seismic Assault is used; magical armor helps.

maco.combo: Maco Fly! to slow and shield himself, Maco Sparkle! from range for a longer stun, Maco Gift! to heal allies or damage enemies, then a fully charged Maco Strike!
maco.winCondition: Land long-distance Sparkle! stuns and charged Strike! pushes while healing and speeding up allies with Gift!
maco.passive: Mach Speed! builds movement speed while moving and grants slow immunity at full stacks, lost when hit by heroes.
maco.playWith: A roaming, pick-oriented team that can follow his stuns.
maco.playAgainst: Hit him to remove Mach Speed! stacks. Maco Sparkle! is slow-moving and stuns longest at range, so sidestep it or close the distance; dodge the charged Strike! line.

morigesh.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
morigesh.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
morigesh.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
morigesh.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
morigesh.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

mourn.combo: Abduct to pull a target in, Beguile to Mesmerize the group, Contagion to heal allies and shred enemy armor, and Eclipse to blind the enemy team's vision and spread Contagion map-wide.
mourn.winCondition: Pull a target into his team with Abduct, lock the fight with Beguile and keep allies healthy with Contagion.
mourn.passive: Extract: his next basic attack cleaves for bonus damage and restores health.
mourn.playWith: Burst damage that punishes his pulled or Mesmerized target and benefits from the armor shred.
mourn.playAgainst: Abduct and Beguile are both visible channels that slow Mourn, so sidestep the vines and walk out of the growing Beguile radius before it erupts. Anti-heal blunts Contagion and Extract.

murdock.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
murdock.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
murdock.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
murdock.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
murdock.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

muriel.combo: Throw Alacrity for a shield and speed, place Consecrated Ground for ally attack speed and healing, fully charge Serenity for a stun, and use Reversal of Fortune to fly to an ally anywhere and knock up enemies on arrival.
muriel.winCondition: Keep the carry alive with shields and Reversal of Fortune saves while Sentinel cuts enemy healing.
muriel.passive: Sentinel: her damaging abilities cut enemy healing and her abilities boost allies' healing and shielding received.
muriel.playWith: A hyper-carry she can shield and a team that can follow her global ult into a fight.
muriel.playAgainst: Watch for the charging Serenity bolt and step out of its line before it reaches max charge. When Reversal of Fortune is down she cannot join distant fights, so pick off her side lanes then.

narbash.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
narbash.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
narbash.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
narbash.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
narbash.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

neon.combo: Cast basic abilities to build 3 Thread, then Overclock Data Burst to slow and Mesmerize, follow with L.I.N.X true damage and an Erase Vector dash into the exploding Jolt; Final Thread Overclocks everything and its recast bomb finishes low targets.
neon.winCondition: Chunk enemies with Overclocked abilities in lane and teamfights, then use Final Thread to chain several Overclocked casts and execute with the bomb.
neon.passive: Neural Network: every 3 basic ability casts Overclock her next basic ability for an extra effect.
neon.playWith: Frontliners or engage supports who keep enemies in Data Burst range and give her time to cycle Thread.
neon.playAgainst: Watch her Thread count and respect the next ability when she is at 3, since Overclocked Data Burst Mesmerizes. Dodge the lobbed Data Burst before it detonates, and engage after Erase Vector is spent, which is her only dash. Magic armor helps but L.I.N.X return and pulse are true damage.

phase.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
phase.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
phase.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
phase.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
phase.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

rampage.combo: Pick up Boulder Throw, Pounce in to shatter it on landing for an area stun, Rumble to slow, then Behemoth to grow, heal and get an instant Boulder Throw and longer Pounce.
rampage.winCondition: Engage with Pounce and Boulder Throw, then out-sustain fights in Behemoth, especially near several enemies.
rampage.passive: King of the Jungle: bonus health regeneration, doubled in the jungle, and tenacity plus a heal when he is immobilized.
rampage.playWith: Follow-up damage that punishes the targets he stuns and knocks back.
rampage.playAgainst: Dodge the thrown boulder and watch for him carrying one before a Pounce. Anti-heal cuts his regeneration and Behemoth healing, and kiting him out of Behemoth's duration wastes it.

renna.combo: Mortal Coil to pull enemies together and heal from them, Stupor from the air to Mesmerize, Soulfire waves for damage, then Abyssal Rift to teleport in and fire the singularity.
renna.winCondition: Collect Essence to grow every ability, then zone fights with Mortal Coil and Abyssal Rift and execute low targets.
renna.passive: Echoes of the Damned: nearby deaths can drop Essence (heroes always do) that she collects to empower her abilities, and she can hover after a mid-air jump.
renna.playWith: A frontline that keeps enemies inside Mortal Coil and the singularity.
renna.playAgainst: Watch for the 1.5s Abyssal Rift channel and leave the target area, and dodge the Stupor orb after she rises. Anti-heal cuts Mortal Coil healing; trade early before she stacks Essence.

revenant.combo: Scar to apply Marked stacks, Obliterate missiles that prioritize the Marked target, consume stacks for a root, then Reckoning to pull one hero into the Nether Realm and steal their power.
revenant.winCondition: Isolate a target with Reckoning and crit them down 1v1, taking extra bounty gold on the kill.
revenant.passive: Bounty Hunter: physical power scales with crit chance and bonus attack speed, and hero kills give extra gold.
revenant.playWith: A team that can fight the remaining four while he duels one target in the Nether Realm.
revenant.playAgainst: Dodge the Scar orb, since it sets up the root and focuses Obliterate. Do not get caught alone when Reckoning is up; armor helps against his physical damage.

riktor.combo: Riplash to pull a hero in, Shock Therapy to break their shield and silence, Electrocute aura for damage and a shield, then Skewer to suppress everyone in front of him.
riktor.winCondition: Land Riplash and chain silence and suppress so the target cannot fight back while their cooldowns stay frozen.
riktor.passive: Suspended Sentence: while his abilities immobilize or silence a hero, their cooldowns stop ticking.
riktor.playWith: Burst that deletes his pulled or suppressed target.
riktor.playAgainst: Stay behind minions or spaced so Riplash cannot reach you, and fight while it is on cooldown. Tenacity shortens the chain, which also shortens the cooldown freeze.

scarlett.combo: First Intent dash in for a shield, Ashen Vow outer edge to slow and empower Cindara, Swan Song to restrain the target and set her blade Ablaze, then Minueta stabs to execute.
scarlett.winCondition: Land Swan Song on a key target to restrain them and spend the Ablaze window with longer range and more power, finishing with Minueta.
scarlett.passive: Last Light: she uses Energy instead of Mana, restores Energy on takedowns, and turns bonus mana into physical power.
scarlett.playWith: Engage or CC teammates who group enemies for Ashen Vow and help her reach the restrained target.
scarlett.playAgainst: Ashen Vow has a short channel and its slow is on the outer edge, so step inside or away. She is Unstoppable during Swan Song, so save CC for after it; fight her after First Intent's shield is spent. Armor answers her physical damage.

serath.combo: Ascend to dive onto the backline, Chastise to slow and reset her basic attack, Heaven's Fury to go untargetable and strike, then Heresy for speed, attack speed and true-damage burns.
serath.winCondition: Dive the backline, get the first takedown and chain free Heresy activations from Fallen Grace.
serath.passive: Fallen Grace: hero takedowns drop a visage that, when touched, activates Heresy for free and cuts her basic ability cooldowns.
serath.playWith: A frontline that creates her dive angle and CC that holds targets for her.
serath.playAgainst: Do not waste CC or burst during Heaven's Fury, since she is invulnerable then; hit her as she lands from Ascend. Deny the first kill so she cannot pick up the visage.

sevarog.combo: Phantom Rush to fly through and fear enemies, Subjugate to chain them in place, Siphon to steal max health, then Colossal Blow to knock them back.
sevarog.winCondition: Farm Souls with ability last hits to reach his tiers, then lock fights with fear and Subjugate while Siphon makes him tankier.
sevarog.passive: Reaper of Souls: ability kills give Souls for bonus health, with tiers adding omnivamp, a magical armor shred aura, stronger Siphon and damage reflect.
sevarog.playWith: A team that turns his fear and Subjugate lockdown into kills.
sevarog.playAgainst: Do not walk out of Subjugate while chained, since leaving stuns you; wait it out. Contest his last hits early to slow his Souls, and position so Colossal Blow cannot knock you into his team.

shinbi.combo: Rushing Beat dashes through the target → Line Tempo wolf → Circle Rhythm for shield and speed → All-Kill! once Track is maxed
shinbi.winCondition: hit heroes with abilities to max Track, then cast All-Kill! to drop a wolf pack on every hero she recently damaged
shinbi.passive: Biting Melody adds magical damage on-hit; every few seconds an empowered basic applies Track and restores mana
shinbi.playWith: teammates who engage or slow so she can dash in and land every ability for Track
shinbi.playAgainst: All-Kill! only works once she has stacked Track, so do not trade abilities with her for free; fight after Rushing Beat charges are spent, burst through Circle Rhythm's shield, and buy magical armor if she gets ahead

skylar.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
skylar.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
skylar.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
skylar.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
skylar.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

sparrow.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
sparrow.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
sparrow.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
sparrow.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
sparrow.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

steel.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
steel.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
steel.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
steel.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
steel.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

terra.combo: Wild Rush charge to knock back → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow or empowered root → Unstoppable Force cleanse and armor
terra.winCondition: engage with an unstoppable Wild Rush, use Hersir empowerment for roots and shields, and dive towers with Unstoppable Force
terra.passive: Hersir stacks from damage empower her next basic ability
terra.playWith: follow-up damage that capitalises on her knockback and roots
terra.playAgainst: do not CC her during Wild Rush's charge or Unstoppable Force's tenacity window; kite until they end, and buy armor since Highland Hurl shreds it

the-fey.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
the-fey.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
the-fey.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
the-fey.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
the-fey.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

twinblast.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
twinblast.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
twinblast.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
twinblast.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
twinblast.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

valmont.combo: Arterial Grip to ground and slow → Bloodbound for attack speed → basics to trigger Hemophagia → Exsanguinate bats to heal
valmont.winCondition: bind a target with Arterial Grip and out-sustain them with Hemophagia strikes and Exsanguinate's healing
valmont.passive: Hemophagia makes Lilith strike targets hit by his basics or Bloodbound, and takedowns restore mana
valmont.playWith: frontliners who keep enemies in range so his bind and bats keep landing
valmont.playAgainst: Arterial Grip breaks if you CC him, break line of sight, or get far enough away; buy anti-heal against Exsanguinate and magical armor

wraith.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
wraith.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
wraith.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
wraith.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
wraith.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

wukong.combo: Pole Vault leap in (Body) → High Impact slam slow → switch stance → Cyclebreaker spin and stun throw → Windsurge dash
wukong.winCondition: swap stances for the right tool and keep damaging enemies to spawn clones that add pressure
wukong.passive: Somersault lets him double jump into the air
wukong.playWith: teammates who fight alongside his clones and follow up on his stun
wukong.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; avoid the Cyclebreaker throw stun, and wait out its damage-reduction spin before bursting him

yin.combo: Lash Kick in for the slow → Windburn for range and cleave → third-hit max-health damage and heal → Backlash to push away, Quelling Gale to stop projectiles
yin.winCondition: stick with Lash Kick, ramp Rising Storm attack speed and out-trade with Windburn's healing third hits
yin.passive: Rising Storm stacks from basics and Lash Kick grant attack speed
yin.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick off isolated targets
yin.playAgainst: Backlash reflects projectiles and Quelling Gale halts them, so use melee or ground effects while they are up; fight after Lash Kick is used, and buy anti-heal against Windburn

yurei.combo: Whispering Echoes or Anima Burst apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul Rip targets → Soulstorm pulls them in and resets Severance
yurei.winCondition: chain Severance resets off Soul Rip to stick to a target and burst in melee
yurei.passive: casting an ability makes her next two basics ranged, faster and bouncing
yurei.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
yurei.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip to reset Severance, so dodge Whispering Echoes and punish when Severance is on cooldown; walk out of Soulstorm before its pull, and buy anti-heal against Anima Burst

zarus.combo: Evade in → Barricade to block then swing for a stun → Spear of Nyr (bonus damage on low targets) → Coliseum leap to finish
zarus.winCondition: leap onto a target with Coliseum for doubled Gladiator power and secure kills to stack permanent power
zarus.passive: Gladiator stacks grant physical power and heal him as they fall off after combat
zarus.playWith: a team that follows his Coliseum leap onto the target
zarus.playAgainst: Barricade only blocks from the front, so hit him from the side or behind and dodge its swing stun; disengage during Coliseum's doubled-power window, and buy armor and anti-heal

zinx.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
zinx.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
zinx.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
zinx.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
zinx.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal
